info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Rules-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules API provides access to the rules governing the accumulation and redemption of loyalty points in hotel programs. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the specific criteria and policies that define how points are earned and spent, ensuring alignment with company standards. Typical consumers of this API include hotel operators, developers integrating loyalty programs, and business analysts seeking insights into loyalty strategies. It serves to enhance customer engagement by providing clear guidelines on loyalty rewards.

get.summary: Retrieve the rules for point management.
get.description: This operation allows you to fetch the rules governing point allocation and usage within the system, enabling users and developers to understand how points are earned and spent.
